definitions.priority: |firm ∪ named ∪ direct| — firm: non-transferring sample scripts whose every host wall is a guard the target's rows name; named: non-transferring scripts the rows name; direct: the target IS a transferring, never-MATCHed sample script (its capture verifies it)
definitions.upper: non-transferring sample scripts touching any named guard (a ceiling, not a promise)
definitions.NEEDS_CHART: no row, section or preamble names a chart this parser can read for the target, so its chart is the house default, a guess: never batched; a person names the chart in the row
definitions.chartSource: where the chart was read: row | section (the heading above the table) | preamble (explicit EXCH:SYM only) | census (the E-census pool's house chart, on purpose) | default
definitions.capturedOn: every chart a committed capture of this exact source sha is on (any directory)
